title: RUNA AI
subtitle: Content generation
intro: A Telegram bot with a web Mini App for AI content: text, images, and video. Users interact via bot or web UI, pick models, send prompts, and receive results. Requests route to external providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Replicate, Midjourney, etc.) with quotas and cost awareness.

archDetails.bot: aiogram v3, commands, Redis FSM, throttling (2 rps), idempotency. Streaming replies and attachments up to 20 MB.
archDetails.api: FastAPI for CRUD, provider routing, S3 presigned uploads. Validates WebApp initData for auth.
archDetails.mini: Next.js 15 for settings, dialog review, and content generation.
archDetails.db: Tortoise ORM with PostgreSQL (prod) or SQLite (dev). Migrations via Aerich.
archDetails.queue: RabbitMQ (aio-pika) for async jobs such as S3 cleanup.
archDetails.storage: S3 (MinIO in dev) for attachments — 30‑day retention (7 days for video). Presigned URLs for upload/download.

bottomBody: Payments, security, and access roles are implemented. Task queues and async work through a message broker.
